l01.text: [excited] Gus! Our flight is at ten! Are you ready?

l02.text: [proudly] I am ready. I packed my bag.

l04.text: [shocked] Burgers?! Gus, you packed twenty burgers!

l06.text: [firmly] We are going to Spain, not to the moon!

l09.text: [friendly] Good morning! Can I see your passport, please?

l11.text: [warmly] Thank you. And the passport for your friend?

l13.text: [confused] Sir... this is a photo of an egg.

l14.text: [deadpan] It was a long time ago.

l16.text: [apologetic] Oh no. Your bag is too heavy. The limit is twenty-three kilos.

l17.text: [embarrassed] Sorry! My bag is too heavy... because of HIS burgers.

l18.text: [determined] No problem. I can fix this.

l21.text: [cheerful] Here are your boarding passes. Gate twelve. Have a nice flight!

l23.text: [strict] Next! Put your bag and your phone in the box, please.

l28.text: [stern] Stop! Do you have any metal?

l31.text: [proudly] Only my golden tie clip. It was a gift from my grandma.

l35.text: [worried] Our flight is in twenty minutes! Where is gate twelve?

l39.text: [politely] Excuse me, where is gate twelve?

l40.text: [friendly] Gate twelve? Go straight and turn left.

l42.text: [smiling] Hello again! Gus, no burgers on the plane, okay?

l45.text: [PA voice] Attention, please. Flight two-oh-seven to Madrid is delayed. New departure time: twelve o'clock.

l46.text: [disappointed] Oh no! Our flight is delayed. Two hours!

l47.text: [hopeful] Two hours... Do they sell burgers here?

l48.text: [firmly] No more burgers! You ate three at check-in!

l51.text: [dreamy] Look, Sofia. Geese. They don't wait two hours.

l53.text: [cheerful] Welcome on board! Oh, hello again!

l55.text: [friendly] Row fourteen. Window or aisle seat?

l56.text: [quickly] Window! I want to see my family.

l58.text: [proudly] My cousins fly at this height.

l60.text: [deadpan] ...Of course you have an Uncle Gary.

l61.text: [friendly] Would you like chicken or fish?

l65.text: [sighs] Then fish, please. A big one.

l66.text: [PA voice, cheerful] Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Madrid! Have a nice day!

l69.text: [outraged] Uncle Gary! You ate my emergency food!

l72.text: [cheerful] Let's practice! Say it with me!

q01.text: [excited] Quick quiz! What did Gus pack in his bag?

l73.text: [curious] Where do YOU want to fly? Write the city in the comments!

l74.text: [cheerful] Have a nice flight! See you next time! Bye!

l75.text: [deadpan] Bye bye. I'm flying home with Gary.

e1.text: [friendly] A passport is your travel ID. You show it at check-in.

e2.text: [friendly] Heavy means a lot of weight. The opposite is light.

e3.text: [friendly] A gate is the door to your plane.

e4.text: [friendly] Delayed means late. The plane is not on time.

e5.text: [friendly] A window seat is next to the window. An aisle seat is next to the walkway.

e6.text: [friendly] We say this to people who are travelling.
